definitions.world_heading: Unwrapped Euler yaw from quaternion wxyz. Not identical to integrated world angular velocity Z when tilted.
definitions.reward_rates: Pose -8*(gx^2+gy^2); angular XY -.1*(wx^2+wy^2); world yaw 4*exp(-(cmd_wz-world_wz)^2/.25). Multiply by .02 for weighted per-step values. Not total/AMP rewards.
definitions.time: Post-step telemetry labelled step*.02; moving command steps100-749 inclusive.

limitations: One independently trained seed and one evaluation seed; no statistical generalization claim.
Same environment and randomization settings do not guarantee identical random draws after a network architecture change.
Explicit velocity OFF removes both the actor velocity input and its supervised head; teacher and student input pathways change. It does not isolate estimator prediction error alone.
Generator-terrain vs plane is not a pure terrain ablation because environment construction can alter subsequent random draws.
No foot-contact or velocity-head telemetry; no hardware readiness established.
Convergence criteria not approved; no automated checkpoint selection.
